name: commit-every-task
description: Automatically creates a git commit after each completed task. Uses conventional commit format based on the task description. Creates granular save points for agent work.
author: Qwen Code AI Engineering

afterTurn: After completing a task, check git status. If there are changes, create a commit with a descriptive message based on the task. Use conventional commit format: 'feat:', 'fix:', 'refactor:', 'test:', 'docs:', 'chore:'. Never commit if there are no changes. Never force push.
